data.one_liner: A collection of utility hooks for Flutter, including BLoC integration and controllers.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of frequently used hooks gathered in one place, including hooks for BLoC state management, text editing controllers, debounce, throttle, and disposables. It also exports package:flutter_hooks for convenience.
use_when: You are using flutter_hooks and want ready-made hooks for BLoC integration.
You need convenient utility hooks like useDebounce, useThrottle, or useDisposable.
You want consistent versioning and better discoverability for common hooks.
avoid_when: You do not use flutter_hooks in your project.
You prefer traditional stateful widgets over hooks.
strengths: Bundles useful BLoC hooks like useBloc, useBlocListener, and useBlocState.
Exports package:flutter_hooks so you don't need to add it separately.
weaknesses: Adds a dependency on flutter_hooks and bloc.
Limited to the specific set of hooks provided by the package.
data.setup_notes: Add leancode_hooks to your pubspec.yaml dependencies.

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want standard BLoC and Cubit state management widgets without using hooks.

alternatives.name: flutter_bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer official BLoC widgets like BlocBuilder and BlocListener instead of hook-based equivalents.
